body.statement: In the binary randomized-treatment sample-selection model of Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes, Assumptions A--B impose randomized treatment and monotone employment selection, the always-employed principal stratum is \(EE=\{S(0)=S(1)=1\}\), and Proposition 1 gives a partial-identification result for the always-employed wage target under those restrictions.

attestation.note: The source, locator, and restricted comparative scope were supplied in the round-6 orchestrator directive; the node paraphrases rather than quotes the published result.

body.justification: This is the published substrate needed to state the restricted always-employed embedding accurately.
body.gap: The source does not establish inclusion of the present imperfect-compliance class.
body.consumer: The discrete perfect-compliance embedding proposition uses exactly this restricted published model.
